lines_of_business: All lines unless noted; FEP and SAO follow own guidelines; Medicare Advantage references LCD L34976
sections_in_order: Description (with long Summary and Analysis of Evidence)
criteria_location: Position Statement, one page: three sub-blocks (vertebroplasty; balloon kyphoplasty and mechanical augmentation; RFK; sacroplasty). ICD-10 list in Billing/Coding.

logic.top_level: pathways (each procedure has a list of alternative indications joined by OR, each indication a small all)

k_of_n.quote: meets the definition of medical necessity for the following indications: ... OR ... OR ... OR

logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: No contraindication list. Only investigational statements (RFK, sacroplasty).
logic.initial_vs_repeat: None; no multi-level or repeat rule.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Treatment of acute vertebral fractures due to trauma, when at least 2 weeks of conservative treatment (eg, analgesics, physical therapy, rest) has failed
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Trauma indication differs from osteoporotic; 'acute' yet needs 2 weeks failure; osteoporotic fractures <6 weeks go via the hospitalization route

and_or_ambiguity.quote: that have led to hospitalization or persist at a level that prevents ambulation
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 'or' inside indication two; 'persist' at a level has no scale

requirement_kinds.quote: failed to respond to conservative treatment (eg, analgesics, physical therapy, rest) for at least 6 weeks
persist at a level that prevents ambulation
severe pain due to osteolytic lesions of the spine related to multiple myeloma or metastatic malignancies
acute vertebral fractures due to trauma, when at least 2 weeks of conservative treatment ... has failed
symptomatic thoracolumbar osteoporotic vertebral compression fractures

thresholds.quote: at least 2 weeks of conservative treatment

time_windows.quote: at least 2 weeks of conservative treatment

codes.codes_tied_to_criteria: ICD-10 list 'support medical necessity' (C41.2, C79.51-52, C90.00-02, D18.09, M48.50-58, M80.08, M84.48/58/68) but not mapped to individual indications; sacral codes marked investigational.

external_dependencies.quote: Percutaneous Vertebral Augmentation (PVA) for Vertebral Compression Fracture (VCF) (L34976)

vague_terms.problem: No pain scale, no imaging requirement

vague_terms.quote: failed to respond to conservative treatment (eg, ...)
persist at a level that prevents ambulation

extraction_hazards: Description contains long evidence quotes with Cyrillic/Greek look-alike letters mixed into words (e.g. 'vеrtеbrοplаstу'), so text search for 'vertebroplasty' fails inside that block
Bulleted OR lists with OR at end of bullet
Device trade-name list under 'Other' looks like criteria
Table of ICD-10 ranges with XA-XS 7th-character ranges
interesting_structures: No imaging requirement, no contraindication list; relies on diagnosis plus conservative duration
Different conservative durations by etiology (6 weeks vs 2 weeks)
Level restriction (thoracolumbar) only for kyphoplasty, not vertebroplasty

fit_to_tree.why: Cleanest case: any-of indications each with at most an all; only vague words ('severe', 'symptomatic') and the evidence-text homoglyphs strain it.
